## Review checklist

- [ ] One module owns the behavior; dependencies use public contracts and follow the layers.
- [ ] Tenant scoping, authorization, RLS and append-only history are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] Input bounds, retries/concurrency, recovery and failure states are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Public API/CLI contracts, generated files and translated UI text agree.
- [ ] Applicable checks passed; limitations and migration/recovery notes are documented.
- [ ] Tracked documentation matches the change; no secrets, customer data or ignored local files are included.
- [ ] New assets/dependencies have a documented source and compatible licensing review.
